app.title: TheoremFeed
home.title: Your study feed
home.empty.title: Upload your material
home.empty.body: Your feed only shows videos for concepts in your study material. Add a text-based PDF of your notes or textbook to get started.
home.empty.cta_soon: Material upload arrives in the next build.
gap.title: No videos yet: {concept}
gap.body: You're studying this concept but have no videos for it yet.
shorts.empty.title: No theorem shorts yet
shorts.empty.body: Theorem shorts are found on this device: the app searches YouTube for each curated theorem and keeps only English, educational, safe clips. The first run downloads the on-device AI model (about {size} MB, Wi-Fi recommended).
concept.out_of_scope: Not in your material or the theorem pool, so videos for it aren't collected.
settings.title: Settings
settings.pool.title: Theorem pool
settings.pool.body: {shorts} shorts for {theorems} curated theorems. The Shorts tab fills a few theorems at a time as you scroll; this builds the whole pool in one go. Safe to re-run; it continues where it left off.
settings.privacy.title: What leaves this phone
settings.privacy.body: YouTube: searches for your concepts and theorem names, and video streams. Hugging Face: the one-time AI model download. Nothing else: the AI runs on this device, and there are no accounts or analytics.
settings.model.title: On-device AI model
settings.model.body: {name}, about {size} MB, downloaded once over the internet and then used offline. It checks videos (and, later, reads your PDFs) entirely on this device: free, no account, no limits.
settings.model.missing: Not downloaded yet. It downloads automatically the first time it's needed; Wi-Fi recommended.
